content.answer: Ji haan, Lahore mein LOT-00042 hai: Printed lawn kurtis, "leading Pakistani lawn brand", Womenswear stitched, condition grade A. Rate Rs 480 per piece hai, total 240 pieces (poora lot Rs 115,200). Minimum order 60 pieces hai, yaani kam az kam Rs 28,800. Stock Lahore mein hai; Multan delivery ka estimate chahiye to bata dein, main check kar deta hoon.
